messages:
sophie: Morning — quick ask. We have a product demo next Tue (2026-03-24) and I want to validate GPU quota + SLA fallback. Can someone generate a quota heatmap across our prod/demo GCP projects and call out any zones < 8x A100 available? :eyes:
jamal: on it. will pull reservation/quotas across org and spot availability. ETA ~ 30m.
maria: tagging @sean for SLA note — if vendor capacity dips, do we have an agreed failover to preemptible or to EU region? we need clear fallbacks for the demo runbook. :warning:
sean: we have two fallbacks: 1) burst to our Dedicated pool in us-west2 (reserved 24 GPUs) 2) fallback to preemptible in us-central with auto-retry + checkpointing. SLA impact: latency not guaranteed, but throughput should hold. I'll paste short snippet for runbook in a bit.
vendor-ops: FYI — we currently show constrained stock in us-east1-A for A100 (expected replenish in 48-72h). We can prioritize a soft-reservation for the demo window if you confirm region and time.
sophie: thanks — can you also include H100 availability? demo model might swap to H100 quantized variant.
vendor-ops: H100 stock is limited in us-east1 and eu-west1. us-west2 has better H100 availability but with a slightly higher price point. If you confirm, we can lock a soft allocation.
jamal: pulled initial heatmap (summary): us-east1-A: 4x A100 usable, us-west2-a: 12x A100, us-central1-a: 20x preemptible A100, eu-west1-b: 6x A100. H100: us-west2-a ~ 6, eu-west1-b ~2. I can export CSV and upload to asset bucket.
maria: that matches my quick check. Sophie — do you want us to 1) request soft-reservation for 8x A100 in us-west2, or 2) plan multi-region mix (4x us-west2 + 4x us-central preemptible)?
sophie: prefer multi-region mix to limit single-region risk. Also please surface expected latency delta for H100 vs A100 for our model (just ballpark p50 generation).
sean: ballpark: H100 quantized variant p50 ~ 45ms/token under our batch config, A100 int8 ~ 70ms/token. If using preemptible, add ~10-20% overhead for reconnects.
jamal: uploading heatmap CSV to gs://redwood-infra-ops/quota-heatmaps/1769009999-heatmap.csv now. Link: https://storage.googleapis.com/redwood-infra-ops/quota-heatmaps/1769009999-heatmap.csv
sean: runbook snippet for demo failover:
```
- primary: us-west2-a reserved (8x A100)
- fallback1: us-west2-dedicated-pool (burst) — automatic if primary unavailable
- fallback2: us-central1 preemptible batch (checkpointing + retry)
- routing: traffic-manager policy = lowest-latency + prefer-dedicated
- alerting: page on >30% capacity loss within 5m
```
vendor-ops: we can provision soft-reservation for 4x A100 in us-west2 and 4x preemptible quota bump in us-central for the window. Need official approval from product (reply here) and we'll lock.
sophie: product approves. please proceed with soft-reserve. also vendor-ops — please add expected invoice delta (est $/hour) for the reserved mix vs preemptible mix.
vendor-ops: noted. we'll send estimate in ~2h.
jamal: quick ops note — if you need Terraform changes, don't run a global state lock close to the demo. recommend creating a temporary tf workspace and tag allocations with demo-1769009999.
devops-bot: Reminder: terraform lock TTL is 6h by default. Use `tf workspace new demo-1769009999` and `terraform apply -var='demo=true'` if you're provisioning infra.
maria: thanks. I'll add the runbook & link to demo run channel and assign on-call.
sophie: perfect — thanks everyone. I'll wait for vendor estimate and jamal's CSV confirmation. :thumbsup:
